title: zmx — Session persistence for terminal processes

key_discoveries.description: zmx run <name> <cmd> is a proper command injection API (not keystroke simulation like tmux send-keys). Supports stdin piping: echo 'cmd' | zmx r <name>. Cleaner abstraction for programmatic agent control.

zmx wait <name>... blocks until session tasks complete, eliminating polling loops. Supports waiting on multiple sessions simultaneously. Our orchestrator currently polls tmux capture-pane — this pattern is superior.
zmx history <name> dumps FULL scrollback as plain text, VT escape sequences, or HTML. Replaces tmux capture-pane's limited buffer. HTML mode enables rich agent forensics and telemetry.
One daemon per session vs tmux's single server. A crash in one agent session doesn't take down all others. Better fault isolation for multi-agent orchestration.
ZMX_SESSION_PREFIX env var namespaces all operations, enabling multiple orchestrator instances without session name collisions. Cleaner than tmux session naming conventions.

Uses Ghostty's terminal state machine as a passive observer to restore full terminal state on reattach (cursor, colors, scrollback). Superior to tmux's approach for agent forensics when reattaching to inspect what happened.
